popCulture.title: Pergamon
popCulture.description: The Mysian city that takes its name from Pergamus — son of Neoptolemus who conquers Teuthrania and founds the settlement that becomes Hellenistic Pergamon.

popCulture.title: Pergamus
popCulture.description: Legendary son of Neoptolemus (and often Andromache) — eponymous founder of Pergamon in the post-Trojan Aeolid migration legends.

popCulture.title: Neoptolemus
popCulture.description: Pergamus' father — Achilles' son whose Asian conquests seed the Neoptolemid claim on Teuthrania and Pergamon.

popCulture.title: Andromache
popCulture.description: In many accounts Pergamus' mother — Hector's widow carried to Epirus, whose son with Neoptolemus carries Trojan blood into Mysian foundation myth.
